description: The timestep walk is the same CTC state machine as the recognise step: a run of one class — the space class included — is ONE emission, and only a blank ends the run, so a space on each side of a blank stays two spaces. This probe is discriminating: the run of three space timesteps must collapse to one emitted column, giving text length == derived column count (4 == 4) and a readable gap after the space. With the old 'spaces never collapse' walk the run derived 6 columns for a 4-character text, the count mismatched, and no geometry was reported at all.
